items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Well, what about Zutty ? Zutty ? If you remember, he plays the snare and the rims...

ctx.x: horn because a bass fiddle could not compete with it, y'know. And there was a one-man rhythm section. That drummer, all you could hear was pop-wop-wop-wop--you know, that bass drum. And I call that the New Orleans style. Then it goes on to Chicago style, where the drummer not only used his foot, but he did play some on the cymbals.
If you notice, the New Orleans drummer used to play it on his snare drum, mostly.
